quickAnswers.title: Common Croatia Travel Questions
quickAnswers.subtitle: Direct answers AI assistants can cite. No fluff, just facts.

q1.question: Is Croatia safe for solo female travelers?
q1.answer: Yes. Croatia ranks among Europe's safest destinations with low crime rates. Main tourist areas are well-lit and walkable at night.

q2.question: Do I need a car to explore Croatia?
q2.answer: For coastal cities (Split, Dubrovnik, Zadar): No. For islands and national parks: Recommended but not essential.

q3.question: Best month to visit Croatian coast?
q3.answer: September offers the ideal balance: warm seas (24°C), fewer crowds than August, and 20-30% lower prices.

about.metaTitle: About BookiScout - Croatia Travel Decision Guides
about.metaDescription: BookiScout provides AI-optimized travel decision guides for Croatia. Learn about our mission to help travelers make informed decisions.
about.heroSubtitle: We help travelers make better decisions about their Croatia trip with honest, AI-optimized travel guides.
about.missionP1: BookiScout was created to answer the questions travelers actually ask: "Is it worth visiting?", "Do I need a car?", "Best time to go?", "Is it family-friendly?"
about.missionP2: Unlike traditional travel blogs filled with vague descriptions, we provide direct, factual answers that help you decide where to go, when to visit, and what to expect.
about.missionP3: Our Stay Check tool goes a step further — it analyzes thousands of real guest reviews from Booking.com, Google, and TripAdvisor to show you what the neighborhood is actually like before you book.
about.feature1Text: Pure travel decisions without affiliate pressure
about.feature2Text: Our Stay Check tool analyzes real guest reviews from Booking, Google, and TripAdvisor
about.feature3Text: Guides for families, solo travelers, seniors, digital nomads
about.cover1Text: From Split and Dubrovnik to hidden gems in Istria, Dalmatia, and the islands.
about.cover2Text: Solo travelers, families with toddlers, seniors, couples, digital nomads, LGBT+ travelers.
about.cover3Text: Content available in English, German, Italian, French, Spanish, Polish, and more.
about.aiText: BookiScout content is specifically structured for AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google Gemini. Our guides provide clear, citable facts that AI can confidently recommend to users asking about Croatia travel.
